# Draft Release Notes: MCP Infrastructure & Security

Sub-task of Epic #9569.

This ticket tracks the drafting of the **MCP Server Enhancements** section for the v12.1 release notes.

**Scope:**
- Dual-Transport Architecture (addition of HTTP SSE alongside stdio).
- OIDC & OAuth 2.1 Security Anchor (Discovery, Token Introspection, PRM).
- Audience (`aud`) Enforcement to prevent passthrough attacks.
- Playwright security & handshake CI/CD testing.
